title: Return Values Quiz
description: Check your understanding of returning values versus printing them.

questions.prompt: What value does a Python function return by default if it has no explicit return statement?
questions.explanation: A function with no return statement (or a bare 'return') implicitly returns None.

questions.prompt: print('hi') and return 'hi' do the same thing from the caller's perspective.
questions.explanation: print() writes to stdout but returns None; return hands the value back to the caller.

questions.prompt: What is printed by this code?
